notes.title: The Future of Super Spy Violet
notes.notes:
Thanks to anyone who supports and plays Super Spy Violet. If you finish the game, the developer says they are too lazy to continue the development of the game.

Well... it's true. 
And I'm going to do this meme🤣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535804/bceaf0ba09b7f7dc369688979c08e404df8bbad4.png[/img]

In the future, Super Spy Violet will still get minor updates such as patches and bug fixes. And also, I will use this game as my experimental project in the future.

Oh and also, I'm making progress on prototyping a new game, but I still can't announce it yet.
So let me cook for a while~ 
In the meantime, I will post my research and my hobbies here instead.
Having a hobby is a good thing after all~
